name: Waterlily
source:
You fled that wretched night believing yourselves free. Belief is a fragile thing. The past does not forget. It festers. It follows. It finds. 
[From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Waterlily]romance-club.fandom[/url]]
translation:
那个悲惨的夜晚，你们仓皇逃离，满以为自己终于重获自由。然而信念本就是脆弱易碎之物。过去从不会遗忘——它在溃烂，在尾随，终将找上门来。
[摘自[url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Waterlily]romance-club.fandom[/url]]
